column1: # Proper-noun corrections applied to Whisper transcripts by scripts/import-transcripts.py.
# Only fix names Whisper reliably mishears. Do not use this to rewrite what was said.
# Format: one rule per line, TAB-separated:
# - pattern is a Python regex, matched case-INsensitively and wrapped in \b...\b.
#   Wrap it in (?-i:...) to make it case-sensitive.
# - replacement may use \1 etc. for groups in the pattern.
# - the optional third column limits the rule to those episode slugs.
# - rules run top to bottom, so put longer phrases before their shorter forms.
# Run `python3 scripts/import-transcripts.py --report` to see how often each rule fires.
